questionText:
Consider the real valued variables $X, Y$ and $Z$ represented using the IEEE 754 single-precision floating-point format. The binary representations of $X$ and $Y$ in hexadecimal notation are as follows:

$$X\text{: } 35\text{C}00000 \qquad Y\text{: } 34\text{A}00000$$

Let $Z = X + Y$.

Which one of the following is the binary representation of $Z$, in hexadecimal notation?
explanation:
Step 1: Decode $X = 35\text{C}00000_{16}$
In binary:
$0011\;0101\;1100\;0000\;0000\;0000\;0000\;0000_2$
• Sign bit ($S_X$) = $0$
• Biased Exponent ($E_X$) = $01101011_2 = 107_{10}$
• Actual Exponent = $107 - 127 = -20$
• Mantissa ($M_X$) = $10000000000000000000000_2 \implies \text{Significand} = 1.1_2 = 1.5$
• $X = 1.5 \times 2^{-20}$

Step 2: Decode $Y = 34\text{A}00000_{16}$
In binary:
$0011\;0100\;1010\;0000\;0000\;0000\;0000\;0000_2$
• Sign bit ($S_Y$) = $0$
• Biased Exponent ($E_Y$) = $01101001_2 = 105_{10}$
• Actual Exponent = $105 - 127 = -22$
• Mantissa ($M_Y$) = $01000000000000000000000_2 \implies \text{Significand} = 1.01_2 = 1.25$
• $Y = 1.25 \times 2^{-22} = 0.3125 \times 2^{-20}$

Step 3: Perform Addition $Z = X + Y$
$Z = (1.5 + 0.3125) \times 2^{-20} = 1.8125 \times 2^{-20}$
• $1.8125_{10} = 1.1101_2$ in binary.
• Actual Exponent = $-20 \implies$ Biased Exponent ($E_Z$) = $-20 + 127 = 107_{10} = 01101011_2$
• Mantissa ($M_Z$) = $11010000000000000000000_2$

Step 4: Construct IEEE 754 Representation for $Z$
32-bit binary:
$0\;01101011\;11010000000000000000000_2$
Group into 4-bit nibbles for hexadecimal conversion:
$0011\;0101\;1110\;1000\;0000\;0000\;0000\;0000_2 = 35\text{E}80000_{16}$

Therefore, the correct option is C.
